column1: # G-Get and S-Search against the starting hut's table, reaching the
# The decoded stock corpus shows no scenario getting or searching a *populated*
# cell, which is how the invented `Got 3 gold from active-object tile 200 at
# (5, 9) in Britain floor 0.` and its Search twin survived until the
# crate-wide message inventory found them. Those lines are removed pending
# `cleak/u5-spec#262`; this scenario exists to capture what the original prints
# so the question can be answered from a measurement.
# Needs no seed: it creates the character and journeys onward like
# `hut-commands`, then works the table east of the starting position.
# Measured 2026-09-12, clean. What it actually pins is the Search command's
# `Search-<dir>`, "then the conditional acting-member exchange below; after a
# successful selection, an empty search prints ..." - and both sides show
# `Player: Avatar` on its own row before `Thou dost find` / `nothing of note.`
# No other scenario reached that exchange.
# The cell east of the party holds no active object, so `Get-East` answers
# `Nothing to get!` and the *populated* pickup path is still unmeasured. That
# needs a seed standing beside a gettable object.
